The '''Rebel Grand Medal of Resolution''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] badge awarded to individuals who managed to "''defeat the Imperial oppression at the [[Battle of Restuss]]''." It was slightly higher in rank than the [[Rebel Medal of Resolution]], awarded to individuals who, while not directly defeating the Imperials, nonetheless defended Rebel Alliance members during the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Grand Medal of Resolution appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Because of the player-optional nature of the Battle of Restuss, it is unknown whether the medal was ever canonically issued.
